headline: Five-Star Hospital Review That Just Says 'Would Die Again' Goes Viral
subheadline: Memorial General reports 300% increase in inquiries after mysterious review
summary: A cryptic YelpIt review of the local hospital has sparked both concern and curiosity across social media.
content:
A five-star YelpIt review of Memorial General Hospital has gone viral after confusing and alarming readers in equal measure.

The review, posted by user "BackFromTheLight," consists of three words: "Would die again."

The post has accumulated over 50,000 interactions and sparked a fierce debate about what, exactly, the reviewer meant.

"This could mean several things," explained social media analyst Robin Torres. "The most charitable interpretation is that the care was so good, the experience was worth the medical emergency. The less charitable interpretation is... concerning."

Memorial General has seen a surge in interest since the review went viral. "We've received over 847 inquiries asking what happened to 'BackFromTheLight,'" said hospital spokesperson Dr. Karen Mitchell. "We can't comment on individual patients, but we can confirm that our survival rates are excellent and we have no idea who this person is."

Attempts to contact BackFromTheLight have failed. The account was created solely to post the review and has no other activity. The profile picture is a stock photo of a sunset. The location is listed as "here and there."

"I've seen reviews for my hospital," said local surgeon Dr. James Chen. "I've seen 'great care' and 'terrible parking.' I've never seen 'would die again.' I don't know if that's a compliment or a threat."

The review has inspired imitators. YelpIt has had to remove dozens of copycat reviews from other hospitals, funeral homes, and in one case, a cemetery ("convenient location, would be buried here again").

BackFromTheLight's original review remains up, with a simple edit made three days after posting: the addition of a single emoji. A smiley face.

Memorial General has since updated their YelpIt page bio to read: "Five stars from BackFromTheLight. We don't know what that means either."
author: Chris Patterson, Human Interest
